name: builder invariants + suites
why: The 110 builder suites and run-all.mjs's own invariants are the gate CLAUDE.md calls the lever that keeps engine changes safe, and not one of them had ever had a NAMED assertion watched go red. Output is translated by mutation-report.mjs, because mutate reads unittest or PASS/FAIL lines and the builder tests speak neither. NOTE: two attempts to move the no-modules golden via template CONSTANTS (an unused DEADZONE_LEFT, then a used BW_SFX_JUMP) both stayed green, and that is the design rather than a hole: a no-modules build preprocesses feature code out, so the golden can only detect changes to code that is ALWAYS compiled in. The OAM break below is such a change, and it reddens the golden as well as the OAM invariant.

expect: invariant — both templates use OAM DMA (not per-byte OAM_DATA writes)
invariant — template (no modules) ROM matches golden hash
invariant — game-over tint is engine-owned and uses 0x1E (no greyscale bit)
